summary: Centennial Airport is one of the busiest general aviation airports in the United States, located in the city of Centennial approximately 15 miles south-southeast of downtown Denver, Colorado. Originally established in 1963 as Arapahoe County Airport, it serves as a major reliever for Denver International Airport, handling executive jets, flight training, and corporate aviation. The airport features two parallel runways and hosts numerous FBOs, flight schools, and aircraft maintenance facilities.
faqs:
Q: Is Centennial Airport open to commercial flights?
A: No, Centennial Airport is exclusively a general aviation facility with no scheduled commercial airline service. It primarily serves private aircraft, corporate jets, and flight training operations.

Q: How far is Centennial Airport from downtown Denver?
A: The airport is approximately 15 miles south-southeast of downtown Denver, typically a 25-35 minute drive depending on traffic conditions.

Q: What is the size of Centennial Airport?
A: Centennial Airport sits on roughly 1,400 acres and features two parallel asphalt runways, the longer being 10,000 feet, capable of handling large business jets.

Q: Are there restaurants and amenities at the airport?
A: Yes, several FBOs and on-site restaurants are available, along with pilot shops, conference facilities, and car rental services for visitors and crew.
transport_tips: Rental cars are the most convenient option for ground transportation, as the airport does not have direct public transit service. Ride-sharing services like Uber and Lyft are available but may have longer wait times compared to Denver International Airport. Taxi services and pre-arranged limousine or shuttle transportation can be booked through the FBOs on the field.
local_tip: For the best experience, arrange ground transportation and FBO services in advance through your pilot or flight department, as walk-up services at Centennial can be limited compared to larger commercial airports. The nearby Park Meadows Mall and the tech corridor along the I-25 corridor offer convenient dining and business meeting options just minutes from the field.
